items.title: Aldar公布NOMA文化创意社区及酒店住宅开发总体规划
items.title_en: Aldar unveils NOMA creative neighbourhood and hospitality masterplan on Saadiyat
items.summary: Aldar公布位于Saadiyat Cultural District的NOMA社区规划，涵盖艺术工作室、画廊、本土零售、餐饮、酒店及住宅，并计划引入阿布扎比首家The Hoxton酒店及The Hoxton Homes品牌住宅。尚未披露施工总包价格。
items.summary_en: Aldar unveiled its NOMA masterplan at Saadiyat Cultural District, combining studios, galleries, local retail, dining, residences and the first The Hoxton hotel in Abu Dhabi. No construction contract value was disclosed.
items.gci_opportunity: 酒店建设、建筑劳务、精装修、家具、餐饮和商业物业运营。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Hotels, construction labour, fit-out, furniture, dining and commercial property operations.

items.title: 迪拜世贸中心周边道路升级工程取得新进展
items.title_en: Dubai World Trade Centre road upgrade works record further progress
items.category: 工程实施／部分桥梁已开放
items.summary: 迪拜RTA介绍世贸中心交通改造进度，Sheikh Rashid Road连接2nd December Street的桥梁已于8月底开放，另一座桥梁于10月投入使用，环岛改造等工程仍在推进。属于既有工程的施工进度，不是当日新授标。
items.summary_en: RTA updated progress on DWTC-area road works. Bridges opened in August and October, while further improvements are ongoing. This is a progress update, not a newly awarded contract.
items.gci_opportunity: 道路工程、交通设施、建筑设备及展会区商业服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Road infrastructure, construction equipment, transport facilities and event district services.
items.stage: 工程实施／部分桥梁已开放

items.title: Sheraa组织190场采购对接，连接25家初创企业与17家买方
items.title_en: Sheraa hosts 190 procurement meetings between 25 startups and 17 buyers
items.summary: 沙迦创业中心Sheraa在Deal Dock Supplier Edition活动中安排190场定向会议，让25家初创企业对接17家政府及企业采购方，推动创新产品与服务进入实际采购渠道。会议不等于已签190份合同。
items.summary_en: Sheraa facilitated 190 targeted procurement meetings connecting 25 startups with 17 public and corporate buyers. The meeting count does not represent signed contracts.
items.gci_opportunity: 政府及企业供应商准入、B2B客户开发、技术与企业服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Public and corporate vendor onboarding, B2B sales, technology and enterprise services.

items.title: Digital Dubai报告：20个政府机构已部署超过90项AI应用
items.title_en: Digital Dubai reports over 90 AI applications deployed by 20 government entities
items.summary: Digital Dubai与Dubai Future Foundation发布《Dubai State of AI Report 2026》第二版，披露超过90项AI应用已在20个政府机构部署，显示人工智能正从试点扩展至实际政府业务。
items.summary_en: The Dubai State of AI Report 2026 says more than 90 AI applications have been deployed across 20 Dubai government entities.
items.gci_opportunity: 企业AI应用、数字化工作流、系统集成及智慧城市技术合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Enterprise AI adoption, workflow digitisation, systems integration and smart-city services.

items.title: 阿治曼宣布举办2026品牌特许经营展，30个品牌参与
items.title_en: Ajman announces 2026 franchise expo featuring 30 brands
items.summary: Ajman Chamber公布第四届Ajman Franchise Expo将于11月23—25日在Thara Hub举行，预计展示来自12个国家的30个品牌，为投资者与品牌方提供加盟及商务洽谈机会。
items.summary_en: The fourth Ajman Franchise Expo is scheduled for 23–25 November at Thara Hub, featuring 30 brands from 12 countries. It has not yet opened.
items.gci_opportunity: 餐饮、美妆、消费品牌加盟、区域代理及品牌出海服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Food and beauty franchises, consumer brands, distribution and market-entry services.

items.title: 迪拜市政府开放9,600平方米社区公园，推进35座新一代公园计划
items.title_en: Dubai opens 9,600 sqm community park, first in 35-park programme
items.category: 首座公园开放／后续计划
items.summary: 迪拜市政府宣布Ghadeer Al Tair Park建成开放，占地约9,600平方米，属于全酋长国35座新一代社区公园开发计划中的首座。该新闻是阶段性交付成果，不能误写成35座均已建成。
items.summary_en: Dubai Municipality opened Ghadeer Al Tair Park, covering 9,600 sqm, the first delivered under a programme of 35 community parks. The other parks are not yet all complete.
items.gci_opportunity: 城市景观、绿化、公共设施建设、养护和园区服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Landscaping, parks, urban infrastructure and maintenance services.
items.stage: 首座公园开放／后续计划

items.title: 阿曼投资局披露7个已完成项目，累计投资超过16亿里亚尔
items.title_en: Oman Investment Authority reports seven completed projects worth over OMR 1.6 billion
items.summary: OIA公布七项已完工国家项目，涵盖工业及新能源设施，累计投资超过16亿阿曼里亚尔，并安排在国庆期间分批启用。其中部分太阳能、风电项目此前已经投产。本条是项目组合进展，不是16亿里亚尔的新招标。
items.summary_en: OIA reported seven completed national projects across industrial and renewable energy sectors with cumulative investments exceeding OMR 1.6bn. This is not a new tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 工业园区运营、设备维护、制造业供应链与新能源服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Industrial park operations, equipment maintenance, manufacturing and clean-energy suppliers.

items.title: 佐法尔自由区及工业区投资累计超过58亿里亚尔
items.title_en: Dhofar free and industrial zones surpass OMR 5.8 billion in cumulative investment
items.summary: 阿曼国庆产业报告披露，截至2025年底，佐法尔自由区和工业区累计投资超过58亿里亚尔。当地正继续推进港口扩张、旅游酒店和风电相关发展。58亿为历史累计投资，并非本周新投资。
items.summary_en: By end-2025, cumulative investment in Dhofar free and industrial zones exceeded OMR 5.8bn, alongside ongoing logistics, tourism and wind-power development. This is historical cumulative investment.
items.gci_opportunity: 港口物流、酒店与旅游服务、工业园供应链及风电设施配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Port logistics, hotels, industrial-zone suppliers and wind-power facilities.
